description_en: Updates a DNS record and supports multiple record types and origin server authentication configurations
description_zh: 更新DNS解析记录，支持多种记录类型及源站鉴权配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa update-record --record-id 1234567890123 --data Usage=0 Fingerprint=abcdef1234567890 Priority=10 Port=0 Flag=128 Algorithm=0 Weight=0 Type=0 MatchingType=0 Value=example.com KeyTag=0 Tag=issue Certificate=dGVzdGFkYWxrcw== Selector=0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateRecord

parameters.help_en: The ID of the record. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850265.html operation
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en: The time-to-live (TTL) of the record, in seconds. Valid values: 30 to 86400, or 1. A value of 1 indicates that the TTL is automatic
parameters.help_zh: 记录的过期时间，单位秒。范围为30~86400，或为1。当取值为1时，表示记录的过期时间为自动
parameters.name: ttl

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable proxy acceleration for the record. Only CNAME, A, and AAAA records support proxy acceleration. Valid values:
true: Enables proxy acceleration.
false: Disables proxy acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
记录是否开启代理加速。只有CNAME记录与A/AAAA记录可以开启代理加速。取值：
true：开启代理。
false：关闭代理加速
parameters.name: proxied

parameters.help_en: The DNS record type. Examples include A, AAAA, CNAME, and TXT
parameters.help_zh: 记录的 DNS 类型。例如A/AAAA、CNAME、TXT 等
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en: The encryption algorithm used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is required when you add CERT or SSHFP records
fields.help_zh: 记录所采用的加密算法，范围为0~255。添加CERT、SSHFP记录时，该字段必填
fields.name: algorithm

fields.help_en: The public key certificate information of the record. This parameter is required when you add CERT, SMIMEA, or TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录的公钥证书信息。添加CERT、SMIMEA和TLSA记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: certificate

fields.help_en: The public key fingerprint of the record. This parameter is required when you add an SSHFP record
fields.help_zh: 记录的公钥指纹值。添加SSHFP记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: fingerprint

fields.help_en: The flag of the record. For a CAA record, the flag indicates its priority and processing method. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is required when you add a CAA record
fields.help_zh: 记录的标志位。CAA记录的Flag指示其优先级和处理方式，取值范围为0~255。添加CAA记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: flag

fields.help_en: The public key tag of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter is required when you add a CERT record
fields.help_zh: 记录的公钥标识，范围为0~65535。添加CERT记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: key_tag

fields.help_en: The algorithm policy used to match or verify the certificate. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is required when you add SMIMEA or TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录用于匹配或验证证书的算法策略，范围为0~255。添加SMIMEA和TLSA记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: matching_type

fields.help_en: The port of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter is required when you add an SRV record
fields.help_zh: 记录的端口，范围为0~65535。添加SRV记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The priority of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. This parameter is required when you add MX, SRV, or URI records
fields.help_zh: 记录的优先级，范围为0~65535。数值越小，优先级越高。添加MX、SRV、URI记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The type of the certificate or public key used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is required when you add SMIMEA or TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录所使用的证书或公钥的类型，范围为0~255。添加SMIMEA和TLSA时，该参数必填
fields.name: selector

fields.help_en: The tag of the record. For a CAA record, the tag indicates its specific type and purpose. This parameter is required when you add a CAA record
fields.help_zh: 记录的标签。CAA记录的Tag表示其具体类型和用途。添加CAA记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: tag

fields.help_en: The certificate type for a CERT record, or the public key type for an SSHFP record. This parameter is required when you add CERT or SSHFP records
fields.help_zh: 记录的证书类型（在CERT记录中），或公钥类型（在SSHFP记录中）。添加CERT、SSHFP记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The usage identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter is required when you add SMIMEA or TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录的用途标识，范围为0~255。添加SMIMEA和TLSA时，该参数必填
fields.name: usage

fields.help_en:
The record value or partial content. This parameter is required when you add A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, MX, TXT, CAA, SRV, or URI records. The meaning of this parameter varies based on the record type:

A/AAAA: The destination IP address. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). At least one IPv4 address is required.
CNAME: The target domain name.
NS: The name server of the specified domain name.
MX: The valid domain name of the target mail server.
TXT: A valid text string.
CAA: The valid domain name of the certificate issuing authority.
SRV: The valid domain name of the target host.
URI: A valid URI string
fields.help_zh:
记录值或部分内容。添加A/AAAA、CNAME、NS、MX、TXT、CAA、SRV、URI记录时，该参数必填。在不同类型的记录中，分别表示不同的含义：

A/AAAA：指向的Ip地址。多个Ip时，用","分隔。至少需要有一个Ipv4地址。
CNAME：指向的目标域名。
NS：指定域名的名称服务器。
MX:  有效的目标邮件服务器域名。
TXT：有效的文本字符串。
CAA：有效的证书颁发机构域名。
SRV：有效的目标主机域名。
URI: 有效的 URI 字符串
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The weight of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter is required when you add SRV or URI records
fields.help_zh: 记录的权重，范围为0~65535。添加SRV、URI记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The DNS information of the record. The required content for this field varies based on the record type. For more information, see <props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2708761.html</props><props="intl">Documentation (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2708761.html)</props>
parameters.help_zh: 记录的DNS信息。不同类型的记录，该字段需要传的内容也不同，请参考<props="china">https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2708761.html</props><props="intl">说明文档 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2708761.html)</props>
parameters.name: data

parameters.help_en:
The origin server type for a CNAME record. This parameter is required when you add a CNAME record. Valid values:

OSS: OSS origin server.
S3: S3 origin server.
LB: Load balancer origin server.
OP: Origin address pool origin server.
Domain: Common domain name origin server.

If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the default value is Domain, which indicates a common domain name origin server
parameters.help_zh:
CNAME记录的源站类型。添加CNAME记录时，需要填写此参数。取值：

OSS：OSS源站。
S3：S3源站。
LB：负载均衡器源站。
OP：源地址池源站。
Domain：普通域名源站。

该参数不传或传空时，则默认为Domain，即普通域名源站类型
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario when record acceleration is enabled. This parameter is not required for records without acceleration enabled. Valid values:
video_image: Video and image.
api: API.
web: Web page
parameters.help_zh:
记录加速时的业务场景，不开启加速的记录不需要传，取值：
video_image：视频图片。
api：api接口。
web：web网页
parameters.name: biz_name

fields.help_en: The AccessKey of the account to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is required when the origin server type is OSS and the authentication type is private cross-account read, or when the origin server type is S3 and the authentication type is private read
fields.help_zh: 源站所属账号的AccessKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时，需要填写此值
fields.name: access_key

fields.help_en:
The origin server authentication type. Supported authentication types vary based on the origin server type, which is specified by the SourceType parameter in this operation. This parameter is required when the origin server type is OSS or S3. Valid values:

public: Public read. Select this value when the origin server type is OSS or S3 and the origin server allows public read access.
private: Private read. Select this value when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server allows private read access.
private_same_account: Private read within the same account. Select this value when the origin server type is OSS, the origin server and the current resource belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account, and the origin server allows private read access
fields.help_zh:
源站鉴权类型，不同的源站类型，支持的鉴权类型不同，源站类型是指本接口中的SourceType参数，现在源站类型为OSS和S3时，需要填写源站鉴权类型，可选值：

public：公共读，当源站类型为OSS或S3，且源站为公共读时，选此值。
private: 私有读，当源站类型为S3，且源站为私有读时，选此值。
private_same_account: 私有同账号读，当源站类型为OSS，在同一个阿里云账号下，且源站为私有读时，选此值
fields.name: auth_type

fields.help_en:
The signature algorithm version. This parameter is required when the origin server type is S3 and the authentication type is private read. Valid values:

v2

v4

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is v4
fields.help_zh:
签名算法版本，当源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时需要，支持以下两种：

v2

v4

不传时，默认为v4
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The secret key of the account to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is required when the origin server type is OSS and the authentication type is private cross-account read, or when the origin server type is S3 and the authentication type is private read
fields.help_zh: 源站所属账号的SecretKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时，需要填写此值
fields.name: secret_key

fields.help_en: The region to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is required when the origin server type is S3. You can obtain the region of the origin server from the official website of S3
fields.help_zh: 源站所属区域，当源站类型为S3时，需要填写此值，源站所属的区域需要在S3的官方网站上获取
fields.name: version

parameters.help_en: The origin server authentication information for a CNAME record
parameters.name: auth_conf

parameters.help_en:
The back-to-origin host policy. This parameter takes effect when the record type is CNAME and specifies the host header policy for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:

follow_hostname: Follows the host record.
follow_origin_domain: Follows the origin domain name
parameters.help_zh:
回源HOST策略，记录类型为CNAME时生效，设置回源时带HOST的策略，有两种模式：

follow_hostname: 跟随主机记录。
follow_origin_domain: 跟随源站域名
parameters.name: host_policy

parameters.help_en: The HTTP port. By default, port 80 is supported
parameters.help_zh: Http 端口，默认支持 80 端口
parameters.name: http_ports

parameters.help_en: The HTTPS port. By default, port 443 is supported
parameters.help_zh: Https 端口，默认支持 443 端口
parameters.name: https_ports
